npcs.name: Durnan
npcs.source: BOOK NPC · campaign relationships are custom
npcs.voice: Dry, practical: “Tell someone when you expect to be back.”
npcs.goal: People who leave through the well

npcs.name: Selise Ardent
npcs.source: ECHO BELOW · Waterdeep Hub
npcs.voice: Precise and delighted by good questions: “What would prove it wrong?”

npcs.name: Mara Vey
npcs.source: ECHO BELOW · established character; hub details custom
npcs.voice: Playful, incisive: “You give it away. I call that skipping the best part.”
npcs.goal: Agency, profit, and her bond with Trista

npcs.name: Orren Brassmantle
npcs.source: ECHO BELOW · Waterdeep Hub
npcs.voice: Patient and tactile: “Why someone made it is a different invoice.”

npcs.name: Ilvara Reed
npcs.source: Harpers are BOOK; Ilvara and local work are custom
npcs.voice: Careful and discreet; asks who could be harmed by disclosure.

npcs.name: Kestrel Dane
npcs.source: ECHO BELOW · Waterdeep Hub
npcs.voice: Competitive expedition captain; wants her crew credited.

npcs.name: Sister Anja Vale
npcs.source: ECHO BELOW · Waterdeep Hub
npcs.voice: Compassionate, firm; argues from the cost of failed experiments.
npcs.goal: The people nearest a failed experiment

npcs.name: Captain Rusk Vess
npcs.source: ECHO BELOW · Waterdeep Hub
npcs.voice: Practical maritime planner; asks who comes back and how.
npcs.goal: Honest rescue plans and sailors’ lives

npcs.name: Dracuseth Maw of Flames
npcs.source: ECHO BELOW · Waterdeep contact
npcs.voice: Warm and plainspoken: “I can hold the door. You decide where we go.”
npcs.goal: Protect ordinary people while leaving the party its own choices
npcs.notes: Based in Waterdeep. Not traveling with the Session 1 party. Does not know the Echo mystery in advance.

npcs.name: Nessa Brindle
npcs.source: Original Echo Below · proposed Mending Court resident; not yet a meeting
npcs.voice: Warm, economical speech; asks what a thing must survive before discussing how it should look.
npcs.goal: A steady run of paid binding work rather than a single heroic windfall. Time to teach an apprentice without missing customer deadlines. A workable rental with people who respect private rooms and customer property.
npcs.notes: Reference identity. Use approved outcomes for actual experiences and knowledge.

npcs.name: Orenna Pike
npcs.source: Original Echo Below · proposed Mending Court resident; not yet a meeting
npcs.voice: Dry humor, precise directions; points with a folded delivery slate.
npcs.goal: Deliveries that arrive in a sensible order and leave the passage clear. To retain control of how much work she takes on after retirement. A comfortable place to sit that does not become an expedition warehouse.
npcs.notes: Reference identity. Use approved outcomes for actual experiences and knowledge.

npcs.name: Jori Fen
npcs.source: Original Echo Below · proposed Mending Court resident; not yet a meeting
npcs.voice: Quick observations and practical generosity; asks before filling someone’s bowl.
npcs.goal: Enough savings and reliable trade to lease a better stall. A supper occasionally enjoyed while sitting down. Fair credit for the work of both siblings.
npcs.notes: Reference identity. Use approved outcomes for actual experiences and knowledge.

npcs.name: Pellan Fen
npcs.source: Original Echo Below · proposed Mending Court resident; not yet a meeting
npcs.voice: Thinks aloud while checking a knot or packing a basket; more patient with people than with a cart wheel.
npcs.goal: To try a promising new selling route without gambling all their savings. Equipment that survives rain and hurried packing. A say in decisions that affect both siblings.
npcs.notes: Reference identity. Use approved outcomes for actual experiences and knowledge.

npcs.name: Aven Rusk
npcs.source: Original Echo Below · proposed Mending Court resident; not yet a meeting
npcs.voice: Careful when reporting a measurement, hurried when offering an explanation; can correct an error without needing to be humiliated.
npcs.goal: Pass an examination through preparation rather than a borrowed performance. Replace night work with a steadier schedule. A mutually workable quiet period for everyone using the court.
npcs.notes: Reference identity. Use approved outcomes for actual experiences and knowledge.

npcs.name: Pell
npcs.source: Echo Below · Gilded Compass; proposed encounter details
npcs.voice: Quiet and exact; points to a landmark before making a claim. He asks “On the way back?” whenever a plan describes only entry.
npcs.goal: Produce routes that another living person can follow in both directions, and build a reputation for returning when promised.

npcs.name: Nym
npcs.source: Echo Below · Gilded Compass; proposed encounter details
npcs.voice: Patient with objects, impatient with unsupported certainty. Offers an observation, then says what it does not establish.
npcs.goal: Keep a usable, credited catalog of finds and secure access to tools and records without selling evidence stripped of its context.

arrival.narration: The road broadens beneath the city walls. Wheels, footsteps and distant bells mingle with the wind as the gates draw near.
Broken rooftops rise through the trees. The path disappears beneath weeds, and the settlement ahead seems to be holding its breath.
The branches close overhead. Beneath them, the path leads into a quiet clearing where even your footsteps seem too loud.
The road passes between the remnants of a village. Weathered timber and empty doorways offer shelter, but no welcome.
Beyond the trees, broken towers interrupt the skyline. You have reached the castle’s approaches; what lies inside is still hidden from you.
The  ruins come into view. You slow your steps, watching for any sign that something has changed since your last visit.
The rocky hillside rises ahead. The camp you  lies somewhere among those stones; the wind carries no clear answer about who has .
The trail bends through  country. Your eyes return to the places where the journey first turned dangerous.
Water murmurs beyond the brush. The hideout is still here, and the agreement you made with Yeemik may matter as much as the weapons at your sides.
Chimneys and weathered roofs appear beyond the last rise. The road leads back among the buildings of Phandalin, where your next choice is waiting.
Above Phandalin, the ruined manor watches from its hill. Broken stone and overgrown paths leave you to choose how closely you will approach.
The mountainside opens ahead. Cool air moves from the dark entrance, and for a moment the outside world seems very far away.
Fields surround a farmhouse at the edge of town.
A port city beside the Chionthar.
A supply shop stands beside the road into town.
A fortified library on the Sword Coast.
Rows of fruit trees lead to a cottage.
